heading: People helping you
intro: They can see the people you're writing about and send their own messages from their own phone.
removeConfirm: {name} won't see the people you're writing about any more.
leaveConfirm: You'll stop seeing the people {owner} shares with you, and anything you started writing for them will be removed from this device. You can then add someone yourself.
leaveOffline: You need a connection to stop helping. Nothing has changed.
